interpretation: Slim image (built per Spec C blueprint) is ~half the size of upstream and pulls in 77 s vs 144 s.
1.87x speedup is bandwidth-bound — same MB/s throughput, less data to move.
This win is independent of any lazy-pull / SOCI work. It compounds with future caching.
Slim still includes flashinfer (~2.5 GB cubin pre-PR-41134 fix) and cuda runtime. There's still room to shrink further (~6-8 GB target with PR #41134 + image-baked compile cache trim).
soci_lazy_pull_status: NOT MEASURED. Setting up soci-snapshotter requires containerd-level config (separate from Docker's containerd shim), needs runtime restart on the host. Deferred to a follow-up that runs SOCI properly on a fresh node with a SOCI-indexed image in ECR.
